title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
title_zh: Quant-Arena：面向量化交易研究的大语言模型智能体基准

paragraphs.en: [*]Corresponding authors. \metadata [HomePage] https://lab.einsia.ai/quant-arena

paragraphs.en: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena , a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022–2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.
paragraphs.zh: 定量研究是一个迭代循环：研究者提出市场假设，将其实现为可执行的信号，在历史数据上进行测试，并决定保留哪些内容。 现有基准评测的对象是公式、代码或单个交易决策，尚未回答大语言模型（LLM）能否完成这一整个循环，并产出在研究期之外仍然有效的策略。 我们提出 Quant-Arena，一个基于真实A股市场数据、面向端到端定量研究的基准与公开排行榜。 模型构建特征和股票打分代码，仅接收2022–2023年的反馈，并冻结一个策略用于在封存的2024年上进行评估。 一个现金账户评估器会施加交易约束与成本，包括由模拟订单簿估算的市场冲击。 评分以已实现的超额收益为主，并以信号质量以及策略所使用特征的多样性作为补充。 我们评估了九个前沿模型，其中 GPT-6 Astra 得分最高；但没有模型能在2024年跑赢等权市场。 Quant-Arena 向任何模型或智能体框架提交结果开放。

paragraphs.en: Quantitative research turns hypotheses about market behavior into executable trading strategies. Researchers construct features from market observations, combine them into predictive factors or signals, and use those signals to build and test portfolios. Large language models (LLMs) are a natural fit for this research loop: they can propose hypotheses, implement them in code, interpret feedback, and revise their approach. Recent systems already explore this potential through interactive alpha discovery and iterative factor search ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 定量研究将关于市场行为的假设转化为可执行的交易策略。 研究人员从市场观察中构建特征，将其组合为预测性因子或信号，并利用这些信号来构建和检验投资组合。 大语言模型（LLMs）天然适合这一研究循环：它们可以提出假设、用代码实现假设、解读反馈并改进自身的方法。 近期的系统已经通过交互式 alpha 发掘和迭代式因子搜索探索了这一潜力（ Wang et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2026 ）。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks measure different parts of this workflow. AlphaQT-Bench evaluates the correctness of quantitative trading code, while AlphaBench studies the generation, evaluation, and search of formulaic factors ( AlphaQT-Bench, ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . StockBench evaluates agents that make sequential trading decisions from market information ( StockBench, ) . AlphaForgeBench extends evaluation to generating factor and strategy code from natural-language objectives and backtesting it on historical daily market data ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . To our knowledge, this is the first benchmark on real market data in which models construct features from raw order and trade records, revise their signals using bounded feedback, and submit a frozen strategy for out-of-sample assessment under common trading rules. This setting evaluates feature construction, signal combination, and strategy selection through their joint effect on the final portfolio.
paragraphs.zh: 现有基准测试衡量的是这一工作流程的不同部分。 AlphaQT-Bench 评估量化交易代码的正确性，而 AlphaBench 研究公式化因子的生成、评估与搜索 ( AlphaQT-Bench, ; Luo et al., 2026 ) 。 StockBench 评估根据市场信息做出序贯交易决策的智能体 ( StockBench, ) 。 AlphaForgeBench 将评估扩展到根据自然语言目标生成因子与策略代码，并在历史日线市场数据上进行回测 ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) 。 据我们所知，这是首个基于真实市场数据的基准，其中模型从原始委托与成交记录中构建特征，利用有界反馈修正其信号，并在统一交易规则下提交冻结策略进行样本外评估。 这一设定通过特征构建、信号组合与策略选择对最终投资组合的联合影响来对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Quant-Arena , a benchmark for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data (Figure 2 ). At the input end, model-generated Python programs access raw Level-2 records, including individual orders and trades and order-book snapshots, through a controlled data interface. Models determine which features to construct and how to combine them into daily stock scores. During research, they can evaluate candidate strategies on 2022–2023, inspect the permitted feedback, and revise their code within a fixed budget. Each run then commits one frozen strategy. At the output end, the platform executes that strategy on the sealed year 2024 and measures the portfolio’s returns after trading costs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出Quant-Arena，一个基于真实A股市场数据的端到端量化研究基准（图2）。 在输入端，模型生成的Python程序通过受控数据接口访问原始Level-2记录，包括逐笔委托、逐笔成交和订单簿快照。 模型决定构造哪些特征以及如何将这些特征组合成每日股票评分。 在研究阶段，智能体可以在2022–2023年数据上评估候选策略，查看允许的反馈，并在固定预算内修改代码。 每次运行最终提交一个冻结的策略。 在输出端，平台在封存的2024年数据上执行该策略，并衡量扣除交易成本后的组合收益。

paragraphs.en: Quant-Arena applies common portfolio and execution rules to make these outcomes comparable. Daily scores determine an equal-weight portfolio of the highest-ranked stocks, and a cash-account evaluator applies lot-size constraints and order-dependent costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Out-of-sample return and excess return over the market provide direct measures of profitability. Risk and signal statistics and the diversity of features used by the strategy provide complementary views of the result. Together, these measurements distinguish finding a predictive signal from turning it into a profitable portfolio.
paragraphs.zh: Quant-Arena 应用统一的组合与执行规则，使这些结果具有可比性。 每日评分决定由排名最高的股票构成的等权组合，现金账户评估器则应用手数约束和依赖订单的成本，包括基于模拟订单簿估算的市场冲击。 样本外收益以及相对于市场的超额收益为盈利能力提供了直接衡量指标。 风险与信号统计以及策略所使用特征的多样性为结果提供了补充视角。 这些指标结合在一起，能够区分“找到预测性信号”与“将其转化为盈利组合”这两件事。

paragraphs.en: A common research budget controls how much search each run can undertake. Repeated backtests favor candidates that fit historical noise ( Bailey et al., 2017 ) , so the selected strategy must be assessed on data that its research never observed. The platform also records candidate evaluations and final submissions. These records allow us to examine how models use feedback and select strategies alongside their eventual financial outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 统一的研究预算控制每次运行可以进行多少搜索。 重复回测会偏爱那些拟合历史噪声的候选策略（Bailey et al., 2017），因此所选策略必须在研究过程中从未见过的数据上进行评估。 该平台还记录候选策略的评估结果和最终提交内容。 这些记录使我们能够考察模型如何利用反馈和选择策略，以及它们最终的财务表现。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments address five questions. To evaluate how far current models are from a strong research agent, and how reasoning effort changes this, we compare 38 iterative configurations of nine models (Section 3.2 ). To evaluate why predictive skill does not become profit, we analyze next-day returns by signal decile (Section 3.3 ). To evaluate whether any strategy adapts to the market regime, we trace Astra’s account and exposure (Section 3.4 ). To evaluate what iteration contributes, we pair iterative and one-shot runs and follow candidates through the research period (Section 3.5 ). To evaluate whether models share a trading style, we measure their holding exposures (Section 3.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验回答五个问题。 为了评估当前模型与强大研究智能体之间的差距，以及推理投入如何改变这一差距，我们比较了九个模型的38种迭代配置（第3.2节）。 为了评估为何预测能力无法转化为利润，我们按信号十分位分析次日收益（第3.3节）。 为了评估是否有任何策略能够适应市场状态，我们追踪Astra的账户与持仓敞口（第3.4节）。 为了评估迭代带来什么贡献，我们将迭代运行与一次性运行配对，并跟踪候选方案在整个研究期间的表现（第3.5节）。 为了评估各模型是否共享同一种交易风格，我们测量它们的持仓敞口（第3.6节）。

paragraphs.en: Profitable strategies are rare, and only one beats the market. paragraphs.en: Models rank stocks with some skill, but the stocks they buy are not the ones that earn the most. Opus, Sonnet, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, and GLM show a hump (Figure 3 ): the second or third decile earns the most, 24–33 bp per day, and returns fall toward the top decile, so H–L lies between − 10.5 -10.5 and + 4.7 +4.7 bp. Terra and Astra rise across deciles ( + 28.6 +28.6 and + 38.7 +38.7 bp), and Sol is flat. Average rank correlation does not predict profit: GLM has RankIC 0.046 and ARR − 7.8 % -7.8\% , while Opus at medium effort has RankIC − 0.002 -0.002 and ARR 4.4%, and across the 38 iterative runs the two are almost uncorrelated (Spearman 0.09). RankIC averages over the whole cross-section, but the portfolio holds only the 75 top-ranked stocks, and for most models that is where the decile profile declines.

paragraphs.en: Astra’s lead comes from staying out of the market, not from choosing better stocks. Its program scores stocks only when the median five-session and twenty-session log returns of the universe are both positive, and holds cash otherwise. The first three candidates have no such rule. It appears in the fourth and fifth submissions, the fifth being the committed strategy, after research feedback showed net losses in both research years ( − 12.2 % -12.2\% in 2022 and − 13.6 % -13.6\% in 2023). The rule keeps Astra out of the early-2024 decline (Figure 4 ): it first buys stocks on 28 February, its NAV is exactly 1.000 when the market bottoms at 0.704 on 6 February, and its maximum drawdown over January and February is − 1.7 % -1.7\% against − 29.6 % -29.6\% for the market. Over the year, Astra ends at 1.107 against 1.170 for the market, − 6.3 -6.3 pp of excess return, and 12.5% of its gain arrives in the five sessions from 24 to 30 September. Cash on 75% of trading days caps participation: Astra captures 16% of the market’s rebound from the February low, against 73% for Terra, so the lower drawdown comes with a lower upside. The behavior depends on effort: Astra’s low, medium, and high runs are invested on nearly every day and suffer drawdowns of − 25.7 % -25.7\% , − 17.9 % -17.9\% , and − 26.3 % -26.3\% .

paragraphs.en: Most research progress comes from repairing a weak first candidate. Mean best-so-far gains at valid-candidate indices one to five are 0, 14.4, 16.7, 29.1, and 36.5 pp over 9, 9, 7, 4, and 3 runs (Figure 5 ), but the median gain is 6.5 pp at the second candidate and 7.0 pp at the end of the run. Two runs drive the mean: DeepSeek and Sol improve by 57.1 and 50.7 pp from first candidates near − 44 -44 and − 45 -45 pp excess ARR, and without them the mean final gain is 6.5 pp. The second candidate is the research-period best in four of nine runs, and three runs commit their best candidate. Large gains come from fixing a clear error in a poor first candidate, and once candidates are near break-even, further evaluations add only a few points.

paragraphs.en: Most models converge on small-cap, low-volatility, value-tilted holdings, and style does not separate winners from losers. Eight of nine models tilt toward smaller stocks, seven toward higher book-to-price, and most toward lower volatility and turnover (Figure 6 ). Opus and DeepSeek are the exceptions, leaning toward higher volatility ( + 0.54 +0.54 and + 0.46 +0.46 ) and turnover ( + 0.56 +0.56 and + 0.57 +0.57 ), and Terra stays within 0.11 of the market on every dimension. Earnings-to-price is negative for six models, so the value tilt comes from book value rather than earnings. Similar tilts end in different places: Astra (book-to-price + 0.96 +0.96 , volatility − 1.05 -1.05 ) finishes at 1.11 and Sonnet ( + 0.54 +0.54 , − 0.64 -0.64 ) at 0.88. paragraphs.en: Formulaic alpha mining searches for executable expressions that transform market observations into predictive cross-sectional signals. Published formula libraries demonstrate the interpretability and deployability of this representation ( Kakushadze, 2016 ) . Automated approaches then use evolutionary search or learned generators to explore expression spaces and combine the resulting factors ( Zhang et al., 2020 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) . These explicit search spaces support reproducible execution, but they are combinatorial, highly exposed to noisy backtest feedback, and often optimized around a narrow factor statistic rather than the behavior of the final portfolio.
paragraphs.zh: 公式化 alpha 挖掘搜索可将市场观测转化为预测性横截面信号的可执行表达式。 已发表的公式库展示了这种表示的可解释性与可部署性（Kakushadze, 2016）。 自动化方法随后利用演化搜索或学习式生成器来探索表达式空间，并组合所得因子（Zhang et al., 2020；Shi et al., 2024）。 这些显式搜索空间支持可复现的执行，但它们是组合性的、极易受噪声回测反馈影响，并且往往围绕狭义的因子统计量而非最终组合的行为进行优化。

paragraphs.en: LLMs extend this paradigm by connecting economic hypotheses, symbolic construction, and empirical diagnosis. LLMFactor uses sequential knowledge-guided prompting to extract interpretable factors from financial information ( Wang et al., 2024 ) ; Automate Strategy Finding with LLM combines multimodal market inputs with a multi-agent portfolio workflow ( Kou et al., 2024 ) ; Alpha-GPT introduces interactive LLM-based alpha generation ( Wang et al., 2023 ) ; AlphaAgent regularizes generation for originality, hypothesis–factor alignment, and structural simplicity ( Tang et al., 2025 ) ; and QuantaAlpha treats a complete mining trajectory as the unit of evolution and reuses effective sub-trajectories through mutation and crossover ( Han et al., 2026 ) . These systems establish the value of structured, multi-stage alpha discovery beyond one-shot formula generation. Quant-Arena provides a common protocol for evaluating the resulting model runs with executable strategy outputs and a frozen final-assessment boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型通过连接经济假设、符号化构建与实证诊断来扩展这一范式。 LLMFactor 利用序列知识引导的提示从金融信息中提取可解释的因子（Wang et al., 2024）；Automate Strategy Finding with LLM 将多模态市场输入与多智能体投资组合工作流相结合（Kou et al., 2024）；Alpha-GPT 引入了基于交互式大语言模型的 alpha 生成（Wang et al., 2023）；AlphaAgent 通过正则化约束生成过程，以保证原创性、假设与因子的一致性以及结构简洁性（Tang et al., 2025）；QuantaAlpha 则将完整的挖掘轨迹作为进化单元，并通过变异和交叉复用有效的子轨迹（Han et al., 2026）。 这些系统确立了一站式公式生成之外、结构化多阶段 alpha 发现的价值。 Quant-Arena 提供了一个通用协议，用于在可执行策略输出和冻结的最终评估边界的条件下评估所产生的模型运行结果。

paragraphs.en: Existing financial infrastructure serves several different evaluation goals. Qlib standardizes AI-oriented quantitative workflows, while FinRL provides reproducible reinforcement-learning environments and trading evaluations ( Yang et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2020 ) . Financial language benchmarks such as FinBen and Finance Agent Benchmark evaluate domain understanding, generation, forecasting, and real-world research tasks ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Bigeard et al., 2025 ) ; general agent benchmarks such as AgentBench and MLAgentBench evaluate multi-turn interaction, tool use, and iterative experimentation ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023 ) . AlphaBench focuses specifically on formulaic alpha generation, evaluation, and search tasks ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , while AlphaForgeBench targets reproducible end-to-end factor and strategy design with LLMs ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Recent trading-agent evaluation also emphasizes leakage control, attribution, and memory effects in historical markets ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的金融基础设施服务于多种不同的评估目标。 Qlib 将面向人工智能的量化工作流程标准化，而 FinRL 提供可复现的强化学习环境与交易评估（ Yang et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2020 ）。 FinBen 和 Finance Agent Benchmark 等金融语言基准评估领域理解、生成、预测以及真实世界的研究任务（ Xie et al., 2024 ; Bigeard et al., 2025 ）；AgentBench 和 MLAgentBench 等通用智能体基准评估多轮交互、工具使用与迭代实验（ Liu et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023 ）。 AlphaBench 专注于公式化 alpha 生成、评估与搜索任务（ Luo et al., 2026 ），而 AlphaForgeBench 面向可复现的基于大语言模型的端到端因子与策略设计（ Zhang et al., 2026 ）。 近期的交易智能体评估还强调历史市场中的数据泄露控制、归因分析与记忆效应（ Zhu et al., 2026 ）。

paragraphs.en: These benchmarks also differ in their unit of evaluation. AlphaQT-Bench ( AlphaQT-Bench, ) treats executability, causal safety, functional correctness, and structural compliance as distinct code-level outcomes, with a small number of repair rounds. StockBench ( StockBench, ) evaluates repeated sequential decisions on a small stock universe and reports passive-hold references, whereas QuantBench ( QuantBench, ) studies conventional quantitative models, feature sets, and training seeds rather than LLM research systems. AlphaForgeBench expands the number of generated implementations through many short tasks, and KTD-Fin separates trading-agent behavior from information access and attribution. These designs motivate reporting execution status, financial outcomes, and information boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 这些基准测试在评估单位上也各不相同。 AlphaQT-Bench（AlphaQT-Bench, ）将可执行性、因果安全性、功能正确性和结构合规性视为不同的代码级结果，并设置少量的修复轮次。 StockBench（StockBench, ）在一个小型股票范围内评估重复的序列决策，并报告被动持有参考结果；而 QuantBench（QuantBench, ）研究的是传统的量化模型、特征集和训练种子，而非大语言模型研究系统。 AlphaForgeBench 通过大量短任务扩展了生成实现的数量，而 KTD-Fin 则将交易智能体的行为与信息获取和归因分离开来。 这些设计促使我们报告执行状态、财务结果和信息边界。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating a quantitative benchmark also requires controlling the process that produced the final output. Repeated access to noisy backtests creates opportunities for multiple testing and selection bias ( Bailey et al., 2017 ) . Quant-Arena addresses this requirement through frozen data releases, date-scoped execution, bounded research budgets, bounded interaction feedback, explicit financial conventions, and sealed assessment of one committed strategy. The resulting protocol complements code, factor, and trading-decision benchmarks by connecting raw feature construction and bounded research to the sealed financial outcome of a committed strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 评估量化基准还需要控制产生最终输出的过程。 反复访问含噪声的回测会带来多重检验和选择偏差的机会 ( Bailey et al., 2017 ) 。 Quant-Arena 通过冻结的数据发布、限定日期的执行、有界的研究预算、有界的交互反馈、明确的金融惯例以及对单一已提交策略的密封评估来满足这一要求。 所得的协议通过将原始特征构建和有界研究与已提交策略的密封金融结果相连接，补充了代码、因子和交易决策基准。

paragraphs.en: Across 38 iterative configurations, the best model scores 51.3 against 77.6 for Kepler-1, a proprietary strategy developed by Einsia AI, and only one configuration, Sol at medium effort, beats the equal-weight market. Pairing each model’s best iterative and one-shot configurations, iteration raises the overall score for all nine models but sealed-period ARR for only four. Decile returns show why: most models rank stocks with some skill, yet the top-ranked names that the portfolio buys earn less than middle-ranked ones, so an average predictive correlation is insufficient to judge an investable strategy. The best-performing Astra configuration profits mainly by staying in cash during the early-2024 decline, which lowers drawdown without beating the market. Candidate trajectories show that research progress comes early and plateaus, and the effort sweep shows that a higher reasoning setting does not consistently improve the result. Together, these findings support evaluating quantitative research through both its development process and the financial outcome of its committed strategy.

paragraphs.en: Without feedback, reasoning effort is just as inconsistent as with it. For eight of the nine models the best effort is not the highest one supported (Table 5 ). Terra scores 42.14 with no reasoning and 20.98 at max, a 21.16-point range that exceeds every iterative range, and Sol is best at low (32.15) and lowest at max (22.31). Only DeepSeek rises with effort, from 20.48 with no reasoning to 29.92 at max. With no feedback loop to correct a poor draft, each cell reflects a single draft, so the scores swing more with effort.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有反馈的情况下，推理力度带来的结果波动与有反馈时一样大。 九个模型中有八个，其最佳表现对应的并非所支持的最高推理力度（表 5）。 Terra 在无推理时得分为 42.14，在最大推理力度下为 20.98，相差 21.16 分，这一差距超过了所有迭代式设置下的波动幅度；Sol 在低推理力度下表现最好（32.15），在最大推理力度下表现最差（22.31）。 只有 DeepSeek 随推理力度提升而上升，从无推理时的 20.48 提高到最大推理力度下的 29.92。 由于没有反馈回路来修正糟糕的初稿，每个单元格仅反映单次初稿的结果，因此分数随推理力度的变化波动更大。

paragraphs.en: Iteration helps at matched efforts as well. At each model’s highest supported effort (Gemini: high; others: max), the iterative run outscores the one-shot run for all nine models, with mean scores of 40.88 against 30.18, and has the higher ARR in six of the nine pairs. Across all 38 matched model–effort cells, the iterative run has the higher score in 34, the higher ARR in 26, and the higher RankIC in 28. Matching efforts gives a larger gap than pairing best configurations (Table 3 ) because one-shot scores fall with effort more often, so a one-shot run at max effort is rarely its model’s best.
paragraphs.zh: 在匹配的努力程度下，迭代同样有帮助。 在每个模型支持的最高努力程度下（Gemini：high；其他：max），迭代运行在全部九个模型上的得分都高于一次性运行，平均得分为 40.88 对 30.18，并且在九对中有六对具有更高的 ARR。 在全部 38 个匹配的模型–努力程度组合中，迭代运行在 34 个组合中得分更高，在 26 个组合中 ARR 更高，在 28 个组合中 RankIC 更高。 匹配努力程度比配对最佳配置（表 3）产生更大的差距，因为一次性运行的得分随努力程度提高而下降的情况更常见，因此以 max 努力程度运行的一次性运行很少是其模型的最佳选择。
